body.x: Supertooth(www.supertooth.net‎) presented Bluetooth speaker 'Disco 4' at 'CES Unveiled' of the CES 2014, the biggest IT∙appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.

Boasting 8 watts, a bass reflex system, and a lithium-ion battery that charges via USB, the Disco4 streams music wirelessly for 3-12 hours per 2 hour charge depending on the volume level. It has a 30 foot Bluetooth operating range, weighing in at just over a pound. The Disco4 is slated to launch in Q1 2014, price TBD.

Also on display at CES will SuperTooth’s range of audio (FREEDOM headset, DISCO TWIN, Disco and ARS60 speaker co-branded with Acoustic Research) and auto accessories (HD-VOICE, HD, Crystal and Buddy).

'CES 2014(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases more than 3,200 exhibitors, including manufacturers, developers and suppliers of consumer technology hardware, content, technology delivery systems and more; a conference and more than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries. The first CES took place in New York City in June of 1967. Since then, thousands of products have been announced at the yearly show in January.
